lines: Again. The threshold. The ending that is also a beginning.
Each cycle, the corruption runs a little deeper. The Sovereign remembers a little more.
But so do you. And that, I think, is the difference.
The Grail waits. It always waits. Go.
Again. The Sovereign falls. The Grail pulses. Reality shudders.
But this time, something is different. The stone's rhythm is faster. Stronger.
The cycle tightens. Each loop, the world remembers more.
The corruption recedes. The void tears seal.
But the Anchor Stone does not rest. It never rests.
How many more times?
dialogs.notes: NG+ boss kill (cycles 1-7). Shorter, more weary tone.

lines: The Sovereign falls for the last time.
The Grail doesn't pulse. It shatters.
Every fragment carries a memory — every cycle, every town, every hero who fought and fell and fought again.
The Anchor Stone cracks. Light pours from the fracture, warm and steady.
The Void Sovereign looks up. Not with rage. With something like peace.
"You remembered. Every time. Every cycle. You chose to build forward."
"That was always the answer. I just... couldn't accept it."
The corruption doesn't recede this time. It dissolves. Every trace, across every region, gone.
The void tears don't seal. They simply... aren't.
In Thornhaven, the Anchor Stone goes silent for the first time in living memory.
The supply lines hold. The trade routes thrive. The frontier flourishes.
Not because of magic. Not because of artifacts.
Because one shopkeeper kept the world alive long enough for it to heal itself.
The Null Merchant tips his hat and vanishes.
Adventure awaits. But this time — it's a new one.
dialogs.notes: TRUE ENDING. Cycle 8 only. The stone shatters, the cycle breaks permanently. Credits hook.

lines: The stone pulses. The cycle continues.
Each loop, the world fractures a little differently. New patterns. New possibilities.
I wonder — is the stone trapping you? Or are you the one keeping it alive?
Either way, your supply lines grow stronger with each pass.
The Sovereign will try again. You will stop him again.
And so it goes.
dialogs.notes: NG+ post-boss merchant dialog. Loop awareness.
